digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center binding store and reconciler
propositions: A Jira issue's KEY changes when moved between projects while its numeric ID remains immutable, breaking bindings keyed on the stale KEY when the moved_issue_key table fails to update.

Rebar's binding store operations (get_jira_key, reverse index, note_absent, retire, clear_absent, set_last_get) all key on the mutable jira_key, causing silently orphaned bindings when an issue moves.

The fix additively captures the immutable numeric jira_id on every binding and recovers moved issues by re-asking via ID when the old key 404s, re-keying the binding and updating the reverse index in the same operation.
Bindings written before this change (no jira_id) continue to work unchanged without migration, as the id fallback is not attempted while the key resolves normally.

On DC 8.17.1, GET /rest/api/2/issue/{oldKey} after a project key rename returns 200 with the NEW key in the body, meaning a stale key resolves transparently through moved_issue_key until that table fails to update.
